notes.title: SPACEFLUX 1.01 - UPDATE INCOMING
notes.notes:
[p]Hey Fluxers!!![/p][p][/p][p][b]I'm so overwhelmed by Spaceflux’s reception so far. We got an influx of hundreds of new players and it's been SO SICK playing with you in the last 2 days.[/b] [/p][p]Just wanna let y'all know that I'm aware of the following bugs (and many more) and I'm actively working to fix them in the coming updates. Hot fix coming soon. [/p][p][/p][h3][b]Common Bugs[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Kicked out of lobby, OR round starts and you don't have Ammo on your guns. [/p][/*][*][p]In these cases, just need to go back to the main menu and join again.[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Splitscreen[/b][/h3][list][*][p]You're gonna need 2 controllers.[/p][/*][*][p]P2 loadout selection is buggy.[/p][/*][*][p]P2 firing is buggy on the first round. Restart the game and it will fix itself.
[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Spectator mode[/b][/h3][list][*][p]When you join mid-match, you're put into spectator mode and must wait for the next round. Then you will join the match. [/p][/*][*][p]You are also unable to fly up/down.[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]High Ping[/b][/h3][list][*][p]You may experience high ping when playing with someone in a distant region. Bugs get worse at higher ping.[/p][/*][*][p]Spaceflux is recommended to be played with your friends, or others in your region for the best ping experience. 
[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Crashes[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Crashes can occur, but they're rare. I’m working to fix some of the causes. [/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Please leave bug reports in #bug-report on our Discord: [/p][p][url="https://discord.gg/vs89UWJcCZ"]https://discord.gg/vs89UWJcCZ[/url][/p][p]There you can also find a more comprehensive list of bugs. [/p][p][/p][p]Thank you so much for you support over the years,[/p][p]- Calin[/p]

notes.title: NEW MULTIPLAYER UPDATE
notes.notes:
This update fixes connection issues with online play and a ton of bugs!
This is the smoothest and most stable Spaceflux has ever been!

[list]
[*] Client experience feels identical to host experience on good connection
[*] Fixed mid-match crashes
[*] New main menu
[*] No more online delay for movement options (jump, launchpad, dash, fast fall)
[*] Portals are working again
[*] 100s of other bugs fixed
[/list]

[b]Spaceflux is 30% off! [/b]
We’re having a massive play session on Discord tonight! Join us for FRACTAL FEST, Aug 24 @ 7PM eastern time!
Discord: https://discord.gg/qVfzwxd

notes.title: Horde Mode Update
notes.notes:
The long-awaited Spaceflux update is finally here! There's so much new stuff to cover that I made a Spaceflux Direct!

[h1]HORDE MODE[/h1]
Introducing the new single player Horde Mode! 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38167372/eb81332dbd900d11aca0d906c603f1ec0bdf02fe.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38167372/3574706b3a43f1dfbcfa8500a5f7405d11589f4a.png[/img]

Stand your ground against wave after wave of head boys.
With 5 enemy types.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38167372/eb8498e9e65ba125f51bfc183344ec83a2ca242d.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38167372/e1b48d1b97407613face7b5f350817dbcaea3ae9.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38167372/bafe8df9bfd18bbd46fdff0f783f1fda4a4e5103.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38167372/ef966d1d1a3b5c01ae13f7b5c509ae6db132ef09.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38167372/c15db107722e70a9613daef6c1e3b75f844e95e1.png[/img]

In all impossible spaces!
Compete for the global high score! 
Each map-and-impossible-space combination has its own leaderboard, so there are lots of opportunities to get your name up there!

[h1]THE BACKROOMS[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38167372/c0c9b7dcad8a7ab029437bfcba4e46efe9ff9df9.png[/img]
The Backrooms is a brand new map in Spaceflux! Get lost in an infinite labyrinth of abandoned office space.
You can even try it in Horde Mode.

[h1]COOL FISH[/h1]
Cool Fish is voiced by none other than Gianni Matragrano!
https://twitter.com/GetGianni

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38167372/2ef0c4aa6571b0ad170aa07c5abf3beb9a1e6d48.png[/img]

[h1]LAUGHING FALCON[/h1]
From FLONCH’s beloved Bird Auditions series, it’s… [b]LAUGHING FALCON[/b]!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38167372/2d3a4b81fac5c6c17ff7a135b71fabcaa6b4bea9.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38167372/9a32ddb82515fd94e857aa2a7cc5e8b44775aa1c.png[/img]

Follow FLONCH to see Laughing Falcon's origin story!
https://www.youtube.com/@FLONCH-ZONE

https://twitter.com/flonchzone


[h1]NOW ON STEAM DECK[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38167372/42d865069503cf1caa2a6e3a17cd6f3c7063d9d1.png[/img]

[h1]ONLINE PLAY[/h1]
With this update, I really focused on improving the online experience. Online games run smoother now thanks to better netcode. And Quick Play makes it easier to get into a match. 

Autoserver allows you to keep your server running 24/7.
This puts you in spectator mode and allows other players to fight each other while you host. Once it starts, you dont have to do anything and will automatically keep the matches coming.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38167372/29f11496f09029e005ed95cd5af3b8b38bc6520b.png[/img]


Join our Discord to find homies to play with. It’s the easiest way to get a game going.
discord.gg/qVfzwxd


[h1]QUALITY OF LIFE[/h1]
Fixed hundreds of bugs.
Added key bindings! 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38167372/5e4164da7270a9b515f5d88166a2db3c4fe33da2.png[/img]

Made balance changes to the guns. They're now as balanced as they've ever been.
Gun Balance Sheet: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1AGuRVGi_FiYS4-jVyFTQBbzk2k-C12jY7SVLDsG54wg/edit?usp=sharing


Thank you so much for sticking with me throughout Early Access, and I sincerely hope you enjoy this update! <3

notes.title: Spaceflux v0.1.8 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Spaceflux v0.1.8 Patch Notes
New challenger: Mousetrap (credits to [url=https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCneHej8NQKa9sBXSeY7EmHw]FLONCH[/url] for allowing us to use his character)
Dark King Bro skin is now available for everyone
New fractal map: Head Kingdom
Added 2v2 Teams!
Sandbox mode: build your own map! Use M to pick colors from the palette and middle mouse button (right analog stick button on a controller) to place blocks. Works in multiplayer too!
3 new songs: Red Z, Final Flux, The Platonic Shuffle
Persistent lobbies
Option to make maps indestructible (toggle in match settings)
Head Arena has a brand new look
New and improved sniper scope
Added kills-to-win option in match settings
Buffed grenade launcher - larger explosion radius
Taking damage: low-pitched sound vs dealing damage: high-pitched sound
Added jump sound
New map icons
Fixed lag/framerate drop issues in Fractal mode
Added “your kills vs leading opponent kills” to the bottom of HUD
Detonator is now a two-shot kill
Fixed shooting through teleporters bug
Added credits screen
3rd person spectator camera: press V to toggle camera views
Improved sound replication
Killstreak voiceovers
Rotating character select
Periodic psychedelic mode filters (instead of randomized)
Fixed hit scan headshots in fractal mode bug
Increased kamikaze speed in fractal mode
shotgun/rocket jump - fixed fractal propulsion bug
Shotgun decal - fixed fractal bug
Added missing P1/P2 identifiers in split screen
Fixed spawn cubes, go thru ceiling bug
Player health bars now appear in spectator mode
Added launchpads to Tree of Life - Fractal mode 
Optimized 2corn
Added 6 Star Hotels pics
Decoys no longer fragment in fractal mode
Updated controls menu
Players stop moving once match is over

Note: Spectator mode is intended for 1v1s. Host must set up a 3 player game, then enter spectator mode (in TAB menu).

notes.title: Lord Dude + New Map Release!
notes.notes:
We're starting off 2021 with a new map + challenger!

[previewyoutube=jPCHFzzLWBk;full][/previewyoutube]

Lord Dude has arrived! King Bro's older brother joins the battle!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38167372/cffa9e2ff2008086e64e63e9fef7c08ae0af9f36.png[/img]

We also have a new map! 2Corn is a classic 2-base arena with multiple bridges traversing the deadly lava below. Teleporters connect both sides, acting as a backdoor into the other base. As you may have guessed, it's also fully destructible.

This update has been a month in the making and features taunts, renovated maps, spectator mode, gun balances, sexy menus and countless bug fixes.

For an in-depth list of changes, see the patch notes: https://docs.google.com/document/d/13U0pWrS5_BdTX8G4DXUFnuKu1WQdygQb7o69UoyHkLs/edit?usp=sharing

Also, we're having our 4th monthly tournament on Saturday Feb 13th. Whether you're a first-time player just looking for some friendly matches or a competitive player, please come out! We really just want to have a fun time.

$35 PRIZE POOL
DOUBLES TO $70 AT 12 ENTRANTS

We will be streaming top 4 on Twitch: https://www.twitch.tv/radicalraymondd

Sign-up page: https://challonge.com/sfso4
You must be part of our Discord to join: discord.gg/qVfzwxd

notes.title: Spaceflux v.0.1.6/7 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Spaceflux v.0.1.6 Patch Notes

New challenger: LORD DUDE
New map: 2Corn - classic base vs base arena with multiple bridges traversing the deadly lava below. Teleporters connect both sides, acting as a backdoor into the other base.

Improved spectator mode. Press H to toggle spectator UI
Each challenger has their own taunt. Press G to activate
Renovated Sanctum 
Added cube crumbling sound
Health pickups are now in the shape of a human heart
Improved menus with heads in the background and character select
Button sounds
Laser kannon - laser now shows up for all player instances
3 second respawn delay
Scoped sniper is a one-shot kill anywhere on the body
Faster shotgun projectiles [25000->35000]
Shotgun particle effect
Fixed explosion not dealing damage bug
Indestructible floor for Tree of Life - Fractal
Sofa launcher - left-click launches sofas, right-click places them
ABC blocks in Daycare
Grenade launcher - grenades explode faster (0.2->0.1 second delay)
Players have 1.15x bigger hitboxes
Tree of Life - fractal bubble lighting
Health pickup message on HUD
Updated controls menu
Improved Daycare - horizontal loop


v.0.1.7 Patch Notes

Fixed fatal error bug on match start-up
Player only has 2 jumps now (previously 3)
Grenade launcher - grenades explode on impact
Buffed pineapple damage 36% -> 50%
Removed Teleport ability from game. Needs bug fixes before it can be playable again.

Spawning cubes with middle mouse button:
- Decreased the spawn radius so that cubes spawn right beside you, making it easier to build cover or bridges in the air
- Cubes now correctly align to a world grid
- Decreased the cube fire rate 

Updated Head Arena
Updated 2Corn
Assault rifle - no more iron sights when scoped
Sniper - no more headshots. Two-shot kill no-scope, one-shot kill scoped
Confusion orbs are now color-coded for each challenger
Modified launchpad FOV zoom effect
Increased fractal fog distance
Increased force of shotgun propulsion (right-click to use)
Improved perspective when looking through teleporters
Fixed shadows when looking through teleporters
Increased taunt distance
Modified Pilipe’s color scheme
Fixed player jittering bug


Known Bugs

Teleporters in 2Corn don’t work in split-screen.
At the start of the match on 2Corn, you may spawn falling below the map. Simply wait. You will teleport to the map in 8 seconds. If all else fails, you’ll have to Tab -> Respawn.
If you have the Dark King Bro DLC, playing online with others who don’t may result in a fatal error on match start-up.

notes.title: Local Splitscreen Update
notes.notes:
Spaceflux now has 2-player splitscreen! Grab a controller and play with a friend!

This update also includes: 
- Xbox 360 controller support
- Buffed nearly every weapon
- No two players can pick the same character
- Added mouse sensitivity scale
- Player gravity increased by 2.8x
- Added kill feed
- Sprint is now the default, press [SHIFT] to walk
- Nerfed Kamikaze ability
- Replicated all sounds

For a comprehensive list of all additions/changes please see the patch notes: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1NFhzi_jVjcJCbHiTbU3tlae0cQRRfRRk6jMNM6k9pWk/edit?usp=sharing
